column1: # Game profile of DEAD OR ALIVE Xtreme 3 Scarlet, the free-to-play edition (基本無料版; Switch, update 1.0.6 = v393216). Plays on Android at 30 fps
# PEANUTS: a Peanuts-only profile, not in Banana Native
# Koei Tecmo's KTGL engine on NVN, SDK 6.4.2; modules main + subsdk0 (GLSLC, NVN's runtime shader compiler, the same build as Fire Emblem: Three Houses') + subsdk1 (NintendoSDK_movie) + sdk.
# RomFS: LINKDATA archives that carry their own index (00/data_00.lnk 4.1 GB, 7,099 entries; 01-06/data_NN.lnk; one per DLC), MP4 movies in 00/movie, XHS sound banks.
# The shaders are GLSLC outputs in 17 entries of data_00.lnk (shader_split.py lnk_entries / kt_lnk), in main, and 7 compiled at boot (glslc_capture); the DLC archives hold none
# The game runs at 30 fps on the Switch, and its logic steps once a frame: KTGL's frame-rate mode 0 (60 fps) only changes the presentation (README.md, Frame rate)
# main sets a heap of at most the pool − 64 MB: a 3328 MB heap region. Fire Emblem: Three Houses' layout (the same engine and SDK generation), not measured for this game
# the NPDM declares 0 MB of system resource: IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false, as on Horizon (Big Brain Academy: Brain vs. Brain sets a heap only then)
# KTGL compiles 7 built-in GLSL shaders at boot with the game's own GLSLC (subsdk0; the sources are in main), as in Fire Emblem: Three Houses: captured on an Android
# phone with DM_GLSLC_CAPTURE=<version dir>/glslc_capture (hle_glslc.c); all 7 outputs are byte for byte among Three Houses' 9
